title: Harold G. Marshall, Phycologist and poet (1929–2026)
content: The Chesapeake Bay and harmful algal bloom research communities mourn the loss of Harold G. Marshall, a distinguished scientist, professor, and lover of poetry, who spent 50 years at Old Dominion University, Norfolk, Virginia, USA. Dr Marshall passed away, surrounded by family, at age 96 on 29 April 2026, after a lifetime of documenting the ecology and community structure of phytoplankton in Chesapeake Bay and surrounding waters.
